records.en: The group that only appears when our play levels have reached critical levels?!

アソビタイ！！

records.en: It seems I'm the only sane one left. All alone. It's better this way.

records.en: It's an honor to meet you all! What's the problem today?

アソビタイ！

records.en: You want to play with Rena-chan and I...? That sounds wonderful!

records.en: Hm? Utsubo-san? I never agreed to this? Ustubo, are you listening to me?

records.jp: アソビタイ！　アソビタイ！

よし、二名確保完了。<CR>全員確保するまで気を抜くんじゃないぞ
records.en_original: All right, we've got two of them. We won't rest until we have them all.
records.en: All right, we've got two of them. We won't rest until we have them all.

ひっ！？

え？
お？

records.jp: ――私たちと遊んでもらいます！！
records.en_original: Is to have a great time!
records.en: Is to have a great time!

records.jp: 私たちと遊んでもらいます！！
records.en_original: You will all be playing with us!
records.en: You will all be playing with us!

records.jp: 鬼気迫る顔すぎない？
records.en_original: I can't think of anything worse.
records.en: I can't think of anything worse.

records.jp: そちらの要求は理解しました
records.en_original: I know that's what you want.

records.en_original: But we have our own things that we want to do.
records.en: But we have our own things that we want to do.

records.jp: 簡単に要求を呑むとはおもわないことだな！
records.en_original: Don't think we'll go along with you so easily!
records.en: Don't think we'll go along with you so easily!

records.en: When did you change into your swimsuits?

records.en_original: Could it be... The Three Swimsketeers?!
records.en: Could it be... The Three Swimsketeers?!

records.jp: それはもういい

records.en_original: You all want to play, so you've forced me here against my will.
records.en: So you and the others wanted to play and forcibly dragged me all the way here, Hoshizaki-san.

そんなことをせずとも、<CR>普通に声をかけて下されば良いのではと思いましたが

records.en: You could have just asked nicely, no need for all this.

records.jp: うごっ！
きっとそういうことではないのですね……<CR>ともかく、はい、私も遊びに入れてください

records.en: Though maybe I'm wrong... Regardless, I'd be happy to spend time with you all.

records.jp: がはっ！
正論と純粋って怖いわね
私たちが一番はしゃぐんだから

records.en: I'm glad everyone seemed to enjoy all the stuff we built. Today was great.

records.en: Project Delta was a huge success!
